articles.title: Cloudflare (NET) Names Christian Smith President Of Revenue In $5 Billion ARR Push
articles.summary: Cloudflare (NYSE:NET) has appointed Christian Smith as President of Revenue, tasking him with overseeing global commercial operations. Smith brings experience from senior roles at Splunk and Cisco, including work on large scale business model changes and enterprise sales. The new leadership role is tied to Cloudflare's ambition to reach US$5b in annual recurring revenue through go to market execution. articles.title: Is Cisco Systems (CSCO) Fully Priced After Its 104% Run?
articles.summary: Cisco Systems has delivered a powerful share price run over the past few years. The sharper question for investors now is whether that recent market enthusiasm lines up with the cash the business can generate. After a pullback in recent weeks and a steady stream of AI focused headlines, the issue is whether the current US$98.65 tag reflects Cisco Systems' underlying cash flow profile or stretches it.
